SELECT tem.email_id, tem.email_from, tem.email_to, tem.email_subject, tem.email_date_send, tem.email_date_received, tem.auto_import_tried, count( attachment_id ) AS noOfAttachments, (select tif.is_system_defined from tp_inbox_folders tif where tif.folder_id = tem.folder_id) as folder_type, CASE WHEN ( SELECT count( * ) FROM tp_inbox_email_read WHERE email_id = tem.email_id) > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS readStatus, CASE WHEN ( ta.applicant_id IS NULL AND ta1.applicant_id IS NULL ) THEN '0' WHEN ta.applicant_id IS NULL THEN ta1.applicant_id ELSE ta.applicant_id END AS applicant_id FROM tp_inbox_emails tem LEFT JOIN tp_inbox_email_attachments tat ON ( tem.email_id = tat.email_id AND tat.attachment_type=?) LEFT JOIN tp_applicants ta ON ( tem.email_from_address = ta.applicant_email1 ) LEFT JOIN tp_applicants ta1 ON ( tem.email_from_address = ta1.applicant_email2 ) WHERE tem.folder_id = ? AND tem.email_from != '' AND (tem.auto_import_format=? OR tem.auto_import_tried=?) @@ GROUP BY tem.email_id, tem.email_from, tem.email_to, tem.email_subject, tem.email_date_send, tem.email_date_received ORDER BY @@ , tem.email_id @@ @@

select SUM(cnt) as cnt from ( ( select count(taie.email_id) as cnt from tp_applicant_inbox_emails taie where taie.folder_id = ? and timestampdiff(DAY, taie.email_date_send, now()) <= ? )UNION( select count(tie.email_id) as cnt from tp_inbox_emails tie where tie.folder_id = ? and timestampdiff(DAY, tie.email_date_send, now()) <= ? ) )as x

select tif.folder_id, tif.folder_name, tif.is_system_defined, case when folder_id = ? then (select SUM(cnt) as cnt from ( ( select count(taie.email_id) as cnt from tp_applicant_inbox_emails taie where taie.folder_id = ? and timestampdiff(DAY, taie.email_date_send, now()) <= ? )UNION( select count(tie.email_id) as cnt from tp_inbox_emails tie where tie.folder_id = ? and timestampdiff(DAY, tie.email_date_send, now()) <= ? ) )as x) else (select count(tie.email_id) as cnt from tp_inbox_emails tie where tie.folder_id = tif.folder_id @@) end as cnt from tp_inbox_folders tif where tif.is_system_defined = ?

( select taie.email_id, taie.email_from, taie.email_to, taie.email_cc, taie.email_bcc, taie.email_subject, taie.email_date_send, count(taiea.attachment_id) as attCnt, taie.applicant_id, '1' as readStatus, taie.user_id, ? as email_location from tp_applicant_inbox_emails taie left join tp_applicant_inbox_email_attachments taiea on (taie.email_id=taiea.email_id) where taie.folder_id = ? and timestampdiff(DAY, taie.email_date_send, now()) <= ? group by taie.email_id ) UNION ( select tie.email_id, tie.email_from, tie.email_to, tie.email_cc, tie.email_bcc, tie.email_subject, tie.email_date_send, count(tiea.attachment_id) as attCnt, '0' as applicant_id, '1' as readStatus, tie.user_id, ? as email_location from tp_inbox_emails tie left join tp_inbox_email_attachments tiea on (tie.email_id=tiea.email_id) where tie.folder_id = ? and timestampdiff(DAY, tie.email_date_send, now()) <= ? group by tie.email_id ) order by @@ @@
